notes.title: Content update: Bonus level!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/cae2d19712dc433e50e841d5a046a5887b248d96.jpg[/img]

You've completed all levels and collected already all of the 576 snowflakes? Then it's time for the next challenge! Get prepared for the largest and hardest level of all:

[h1]The Bonus Level[/h1]

It's huge, unforgiving and split in 4 sections, each of them recreating one of the main worlds. You can enter a new section only if you collect all 24 snowflakes of the previous one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/5e7043594fe5ebbd3e123cb3379c4cdc2078f95e.jpg[/img]

Be warned! The bonus level will try your patience and platformer skills sorely! :)


[h2][b]Patch notes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Bonus Level added
[*] Teaser on start screen showing upcoming content for 2022
[*] Chubby will high-bounce off enemies once the jump button/key is pressed and held
[*] Optimisation and several bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Revealing new story and content for release - El Pix is still evil
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Only 1 week left for the mission of the year!
[h1][b]Mission in Snowdriftland will be released on December 1st, 2021![/b][/h1]

Time to reveal new content available in the release version:

[h2]Story[/h2]
We all knew it will happen: El Pix has stolen something - again! Nothing from human world this time, but he broke into the secret archive of UPIXO headquarters and pinched nothing less than important and historically valuable artifacts of video game history!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/09680438ac384cfb707acd4df657ade6b9f7f702.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]Chest content at level end[/h2]
Chubby will find one of this important artifacts in the chest at the end of each level. Professor Schwabbel will insist on adding his two cents for each discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/d90749ba312ed32218d9ffc90d00ec20156611bb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Base[/h2]
The red ship (serving as the base) on the worldmap has been reactivated. You can enter it anytime and check the current status of rescued artifacts. You will also find a display showing the number of collected snowflakes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/93b1245beb6dd667be020265bd36971e2ed75344.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]Snowflakes reward / Bonus level[/h2]
In Snowdriftland reaching the end of a level is only one part of the fun. Collecting all 24 snowflakes in each level boosts the gaming experience and will demand all your platformer skills.
[b]If you manage to collect all 576 snowflakes in the game, a huge bonus level will be unlocked as a reward and ovation for your dedication and success.[/b]
But be prepared: This one will be the largest and hardest level of all!
[i]Please note: The bonus level will be available from December 24.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/370eada4f27de8220633df7149918443eb24f06e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Check out our new trailer in the gallery of the Mission in Snowdriftland Steamshop page![/h2]
